items.content: What events do you specialize in?
Schatzies Events PH specializes in Luxury Weddings and Grand Debuts. We offer all-in packages that include catering, styling, photo/video, and coordination to ensure a seamless celebration.
Where are your office locations?
They have physical branches in Quezon City and Tagaytay.
How do I start the booking process with Schatzies Events PH?

You can start by reaching out through our official contact numbers or Facebook page to check for date availability. We recommend visiting our Quezon City or Tagaytay branches for a formal consultation to discuss your specific vision and package choice.
What are your contact details for booking?
You can reach us through the following contact details.
What is required to officially reserve a date?
To secure your slot, we offer a low down payment option. This allows you to lock in your event date and current package pricing while you continue with the planning process.
Do you offer flexible payment terms after the down payment?
Yes. To make the planning process stress-free, we provide monthly installment plans and also accept credit card payments (note: credit card transactions are subject to bank charges).
Can I book even if I am currently based overseas?

Absolutely. Schatzies Events is specifically known as a top choice for overseas brides and busy couples. We can handle the coordination and important details remotely, ensuring a smooth process until you arrive for your celebration.
Is an initial consultation free?
Our team is ready to discuss event plans at either of our physical locations to help you choose the package that best fits your needs and budget.
What are your official Wedding Packages?
We offer five tiers designed for every dream wedding.
Do wedding packages include a bridal car?
Yes. Lower tiers include 3 hours of use, while the De Luxe and Grandezza tiers provide a Mercedes Benz for 4 hours, inclusive of fuel, driver, and bouquet.

Are the traditional 18 Roses and 18 Treasures ceremonies included?
Yes, all debut packages include the coordination and physical setup for both the 18 Roses and 18 Treasures ceremonies.
What is included in your event packages?
Schatzies Events provides complete and affordable packages.

inclusions: Full Event Planning and Coordination (from preparation to the actual day)

items.content: Do you handle the coordination on the actual day of the event?
Yes. Our team provides full coordination to manage the program flow and ensure everything runs smoothly on the day of the celebration.
Do you provide a host?
Yes, a Professional Program Emcee/Host is included in all our wedding and debut packages to keep your guests engaged and the program on track.
Are the packages All-In?
Yes. Our packages are designed to be comprehensive, covering full buffet catering, grand venue styling, photo and video coverage (with Same Day Edit), and technical needs like sounds and lights.
What is included in the catering and buffet?
All packages include a full buffet (Soup, Pork, Beef, Chicken, Fish, Vegetable, and Dessert) plus refillable drinks. Upgraded packages also feature a Pasta Bar or Grazing Table.
What photo and video services are provided?

Every package includes at least one main photographer/videographer, a prenup/pre-debut pictorial, a Save-the-Date video, and drone shots. Higher tiers include cinematic equipment and magnetic leatherette albums.
Is hair and makeup included for the celebrants?
Yes, professional airbrush makeup is provided for the bride/groom or debutante. Upgraded tiers also include additional traditional makeup heads for family or entourage members.
